The '''Confederacy way station''' was a military base constructed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], near [[Jundland Station]]. It was destroyed during the [[Second Battle of Tatooine]].
